body.zh:
欢迎使用 Pho 社区版
这是一个无服务端、无账号的照片浏览与同步应用：照片按目录保存在你自己的存储里，支持 SMB / WebDAV / NFS 等后端。本仓库为开源社区版，当前提供 Android APK。遇到问题欢迎开 Issue，试用前请先备份照片。
body.en:
Welcome to Pho Community Edition
This is a serverless, accountless photo browsing and syncing app: photos are stored in your own storage by directory, supporting backends such as SMB / WebDAV / NFS. This repository is the open-source community edition, currently providing Android APK. Feel free to open an Issue if you encounter any problems, please back up your photos before trying it out.
